name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Eight

releases.name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Eight

description.text:
Play! Pokémon Prize Packs are six-card packs that Pokémon sends to Play! Pokémon stores to hand out at in-store events such as Leagues, League Challenges and League Cups; stores with more active events get more packs. Every card is a reprint that keeps its original set number and is marked with the Play! Pokémon logo.

Series Eight, released on 1 January 2026, holds 90 cards, 118 counting foil and non-foil versions, from Stellar Crown through Mega Evolution, plus MEE basic Energy. Its foil cards are cosmos holo, except Pokémon ex and ACE SPEC cards, which keep their usual foil.
